operations.title: The cubic modular infinity class is a gluing obstruction between two deck-complement sectors
operations.body: Only the twenty growth-four sheets force nonvanishing. Four individual C5 orbits and both complement pairs are separately boundary-trivializable; the two complement-pair trivialization torsors have no common point when all growth-four conditions are imposed.
